newsitem.title: CHILE: Canada's Westmin signs $140 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Westmin signs $140 mln loan.

text.p: Canadian mining firm Westmin Resources Limited said it signed Monday a $140 million loan with a group of banks led by Barclays Bank plc to finance its Lomas Bayas copper mine in northern Chile.

"Funds from this loan will be used for the building and development of the Lomas Bayas project which began in December 1996 and is scheduled to start operating in June 1998," said the company in a statement released in Santiago.
The mine will cost $244 million to build and will produce 60,000 tonnes of cathodes a year using low-cost heap leaching technology.
At the same time as building the mine, Westmin is carrying out a feasibility study to expand production to 90,000 tonnes of copper a year.
Lomas Bayas lies in the bleak Atacama Desert east of the port of Antofagasta.
